finding: Removing the dense reserved-case jump table succeeded for both Clang versions, but moving the memory eligibility check increased old scalar and SIMD instruction work across the x86 and ARM hosts. Native scalar/SIMD and other-ISA regressions remain, so this candidate is held.
limits: 21-cycle screening with descriptive unadjusted bootstrap intervals; even stable losses below one percent remain material. Other-ISA native losses are not explained by x86 instruction counts. No portable or current-product qualification was run for this failed-performance candidate.
